description: Ordinary project checks only. Configure real commands. Runtime environment and scenarios are separate inputs. required_checks names the CI checks a merge needs (comma-separated, or "none"). protected_paths lists root-anchored path patterns (* within a segment, ** across segments) that only a human may change. No workflow reads either since the shared merge queue left upstream dev (docs/owner-decisions.md asf-follows-dev); merges happen outside the workflows, and tests/layers/test_required_checks.py keeps required_checks matching the CI check names.
